meta.title: Smokeout
meta.author: Probe (The Black Lotus)
meta.description: The soundtrack "Smokeout" by Probe of The Black Lotus (19 July 1997). The soundtrack of Jizz, The Black Lotus's 64K intro that won the PC 64K intro competition at Wired 1997. 2:46, 13 phrase, 11 stored tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording. The intro synthesizes its instruments at start-up with TBL's mini-cauldron sample synth and plays them from an XM module; here every synthesized sample is a live unified-synth instrument (the cauldron oscillator, kind 64, with its comb, echo and doubler as track effects) and the XM's samples the intro keeps as PCM play on a sampler (GSM-encoded). `synth-convert xm` replays the XM (FT2 rules) into notes and per-tick automation (volume, pan, pitch slides), one track per record, XM channel and playback-speed class; `song import` cuts the lanes into patterns. Against the OpenMPT render of the original it is within 0.4 dB loudness and about 2 dB per octave band to 8 kHz (A/B listening approved 2026-10-30); known differences: reversed ping-pong loops attack sharper, extreme slow-downs lose the echo the original bakes in (a quiet gap near 21.5 s in over2). Track names are derived here from the XM sample, the record and the speed class, not the author's. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
